title: What is Inference?
description: Inference turns a trained model plus a fresh prompt into an answer. How serving differs from training, latency and cost budgets.
lead: Inference begins where training ends: a finished model reads a new prompt and generates an answer, running its weights forward without updating them. Every token costs compute and time, so serving is where batching, caching, and hardware choices decide the product experience. It is learning once and answering millions of times, and the meter that usage bills follow.
